title: Reading the staff
goal: Read notes on the five lines of the staff and find them on the keyboard.

steps.title: Five lines
steps.text: Music is written on five lines called the staff. A note sits on a line or in a space between two lines.

steps.title: The treble clef
steps.text: The curly sign at the start is the treble clef. It tells you these notes are the higher ones, played mostly by the right hand.

steps.title: Middle C
steps.text: Middle C sits on a short line of its own just under the staff. From there each step up is the next line or space.

steps.title: C D E F G A
steps.text: C D E F G A go up the staff one step at a time, line, space, line, space. The keys are lit to match.

steps.title: Read a short line
steps.text: Read the notes from the staff. Press the key that matches the amber note.
